items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I called the doctor up and -- called Doc Grogan and I says, she can't talk and I got to get out of her.

ctx.x: And one day I came home-- I was with the band, you know. And I came home and I was going to Boston, I think. And she was fall out on the floor. I said, huh? You can't stay sober one day. And the next -- I woke up in the morning and she was on the sofa. And she couldn't talk. And I called the doctor up and -- called Doc Grogan and I says, she can't talk and I got to get out of her.
So I think I took her to the hospital. I took her up to the Seidenham. And when I come back, I took her out of the Seidenham, I bodily took her out of the Seidenham and took her over to the Bellevue.
